_meta: editorconfig-checker closes the loop on this repository's hand-written .editorconfig.
Language formatters own exact indentation; this gate owns LF, UTF-8, final newlines,
trailing whitespace, and tabs-versus-spaces across the files those formatters miss.
The version is explicit so a stray installation cannot silently change the verdict.

_IndentSize_reason: gofmt, rustfmt, ruff, zig fmt, and Taplo understand continuation alignment;
editorconfig-checker's multiple-of-N rule does not. Keep the style check and
_MaxLineLength_reason: .editorconfig declares no universal cap. URLs, prose, and generated command
lines need language-aware wrapping rather than one integer.
